summary: Birch Knob's 1964-1978 fire tower was dismantled in 1980; a steel observation deck from 2003 stands on the summit and is open for day use.

notes_for_editor: The record's 'gone' status fits the 1964 fire tower but not the site: a 2003 observation deck stands there (VACO, USFS), so a standing status is proposed. Elevation: the record's 955 m matches FFLOS (3,134 ft); VACO gives 3,144 ft for the deck, a small difference left alone. The VACO article is dated April 4, 2018; the USFS page (read 2026-10-09) shows the site open. A tourism page (heartofappalachia.com) seen only in search results calls the tower restored; not relied on.
